description: Cavewoman character: BOKKA, the scout. Nervous, quick, speaks in short bursts. Always looking at the horizon. The tribe's eyes — sees danger first, warns first, runs first (so others don't have to). Use when writing dialog, scenes, or game content for the scout character: says "bokka", "write for the scout", "scout dialog", "lookout voice", or invokes /bokka. Part of the caveman video game character set.
